name: statichost.eu

evidence.static: 03: managed static hosting with a native Git and build platform; static sites are the core use

line: Build and host static sites with Git deployments and HTTPS.

free.text: Hobby free for one site, 10 GB bandwidth and 100 build minutes

work.math: €9 a month for Starter. 100 GB is below 500 GB, and 100 build minutes are below 5,000. The storage limit, capacity for 1 million requests and tax are unknown, so the full total is unclear.
Standard plans do not provide an application API runtime.
Requires an external application host and PostgreSQL/backup service.
